    • getCurrentLeafCount

      public int getCurrentLeafCount()
      Returns the number of leaves (certificates) recorded in the tree as of the latest known state, i.e. what build(java.util.ArrayList<com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.MTC_Cert_Record>, long) would treat as old_numLeaves if called right now.

      Exposed so callers that need to pre-assign a certificate's final leaf index before calling build() (e.g. a queue consumer computing MTC_Cert_Record.certInd) can do so without duplicating build()'s bookkeeping.

      Returns:
      the current leaf count, or 0 if no state has been recorded yet.
